title: Sam Altman and Dario Amodei, in their own words

altman.quote: I’m incredibly optimistic for the future.

amodei.quote: I believe deeply in our ability to prevail, in humanity’s spirit and its nobility, but we must face the situation squarely and without illusions.

altman.quote: Progress has been rapid and will continue to be. But it should be slower than it otherwise could be

amodei.quote: We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models.
amodei.venue: Essay, We Must Pace the Frontier

altman.quote: There should be limits to the amount of power that private companies have

amodei.quote: However, now the risks are clearly here. It is time to go beyond transparency to more serious and binding regulation of AI.
amodei.venue: Essay, Policy on the AI Exponential
